verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agents can pay Channel3 itself via MPP to use Channel3's own API without an API key or signup. Nothing documents a way for a developer to put HTTP 402 per-call machine payments on their own API or service. Channel3's documented developer monetization is affiliate commission on product sales, which is a different capability, so the MPP item is adjacent and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monetize an API or service with HTTP 402 machine payments that agents pay per call without a checkout UI
